name: cyberstyle-platform
description: Production-ready agency website, client portal, and internal operations platform for CYBERSTYLE LLC

scripts.ci:lint: npm run lint --workspace=@cyberstyle/api && npm run lint --workspace=@cyberstyle/web
scripts.ci:typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@cyberstyle/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cyberstyle/web
scripts.ci:test: npm run test:tenant --workspace=@cyberstyle/api && npm run test:portal --workspace=@cyberstyle/api && npm run test:phase3 --workspace=@cyberstyle/api && npm run test:restore --workspace=@cyberstyle/api && npm run test:e2e --workspace=@cyberstyle/api && npm run test:owasp --workspace=@cyberstyle/api
scripts.ci:build: npm run build --workspace=@cyberstyle/api && npm run build --workspace=@cyberstyle/web
scripts.ci:validate: npm run ci:typecheck && npm run ci:test && npm run ci:build
